settled_definition: No fall; final tilt<0.5deg, planar speed<0.03m/s, total base angular speed<0.08rad/s. This does not require return to target position.
requested_histories: 3 scenarios ×3 force magnitudes [0.5,1,2]N ×3 patterns [sameY,alternatingY,cross+X+Y-X-Y] ×3(duration,spacing)=[(.1,.4),(.2,.25),(.3,.15)]s;8pulses from1s;10s runs. Pulses add without clipping.
failure_definition: Existing fork/platform floor contact or tilt>70deg; identical in both controllers.
limits: Empirical sampled comparison; does not certify global stability or hardware recovery. Strong4N combined same-direction trains still fail; several survivors retain position/tilt bias.
